title: Public Health DAO: Broad Street
summary: A walkable Soho campus for the agent-managed, human-governed Public Health DAO, anchored at the Broad Street Pump replica where John Snow's mapped data first stopped a cholera outbreak. Six zones, six agents, people cast the final votes.

districts.real_anchor: Broad Street Pump replica, Broadwick Street

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model, measurable outcomes ledger

buildings.name: Pumpside Reading Room
buildings.use: Public reading of the charter and mission

court.name: The Snow Court
court.style: Georgian square courtyard centered on the pump replica
court.why_here: Honors John Snow's Soho cholera map: the founding proof that mapped evidence and human decision can stop an outbreak.

quests.title: Map the Outbreak
steps: Read the charter wall at the Broad Street Pump replica
Collect three evidence cards from around Soho
Deliver them to the Evidence Monitor
Review the synthesized summary with the Research Synthesis Agent

quests.title: From Evidence to Proposal
steps: Take the evidence summary to the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Watch the agent draft a proposal
Post the draft on the forum board
Watch stewards debate it in the Vote Chamber

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Carry the approved proposal brief to the Operations Deck
Ask the Collaborator Scout to identify public health experts
Let the Task Router assign working groups
Confirm all groups have owners on the routing board

quests.title: Measure What Matters
steps: Collect progress reports from the working groups
Deliver them to the Progress Tracker
Match results against the charter's measurable outcomes
Mark the milestone pillar in the Observatory

quests.title: Humans Decide
steps: Review the Observatory's outcome report
Return to Charter Hall and present findings at the pump
Observe a human-only final vote on the next cycle
Record the decision in the Outcomes Ledger
